providers.aboutUs: Snapdocs is digital infrastructure for the most impactful transactions. The company began in mortgage, one of the most highly regulated and operationally complex industries, and now powers 1 in 5 home lending transactions, providing transparency, efficiency and quality to lenders, title companies, notaries, and borrowers. Drawing on this expertise, Snapdocs has extended its capabilities into adjacent financial markets, including consumer lending, brokerage, estate planning, auto, and asset-backed securities. Supported by a highly-trained customer service team and nationwide settlement and notary networks, Snapdocs helps organizations complete high-volume transactions with speed, accuracy, and confidence in the records that support them. For more information, visit www.snapdocs.com.
